user.title: Configure HA Logger Extended
user.description: Set up the extended logging integration for ML datasets.

data.db_path: Database file path (relative to HA config directory)

data_description.db_path: Path to the SQLite database file.
data_description.exclude_domains: Domains whose entities will not be logged.
data_description.exclude_entities: Specific entity IDs that will not be logged.
data_description.exclude_attributes: Attribute names that will never be logged for any entity.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of HA Logger Extended is allowed.

data_description.flush_interval: How often buffered observations are written to the database. Lower values reduce data loss on crash but increase I/O.
data_description.queue_max_size: Maximum number of state snapshots held in memory before dropping. Increase if you have many fast-changing entities.
